instrument: Jasper County data center and cryptocurrency moratorium
summary: One-year moratorium on data centers, data processing facilities and cryptocurrency mining in unincorporated areas. Second reading approved unanimously Sept 21, 2026; third and final reading set for the next council meeting. Would pause rezoning, site plan, building permit and economic incentive applications; council may extend in six-month increments.
notes: CORRECTION: previously recorded as adopted. Bluffton Today (via Yahoo/AOL, Sept 27-28) reports second reading only; the earlier source described it as approved. One of four South Carolina county actions within about a week (Spartanburg, Jasper, Laurens, Clarendon).
